subject: Islamic Studies

intro: Lesson 17: The adhan: its words and meaning. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: The call five times a day
points: The adhan tells us salah time has come
The mu'adhdhin calls loudly and clearly
Bilal called the adhan in Madinah

head: Words
Meaning
rows: I bear witness there is no god but Allah
I bear witness Muhammad is Allah's Messenger
Allah is the Greatest; there is no god but Allah

panels.title: At Fajr
points: One extra line: as-salatu khayrun mina n-nawm
Meaning: prayer is better than sleep

head: Words of the adhan
Draw a line
Meaning
rows: I bear witness Muhammad is Allah's Messenger
Allah is the Greatest; there is no god but Allah
I bear witness there is no god but Allah

blocks.answers: Allahu akbar (4 times): Allah is the Greatest; Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah (2): I bear witness there is no god but Allah; Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah (2): I bear witness Muhammad is Allah's Messenger; Hayya 'ala s-salah (2): Come to prayer; Hayya 'ala l-falah (2): Come to success; Allahu akbar (2); La ilaha illallah (1): Allah is the Greatest; there is no god but Allah

box.title: The line I like most, and why

keywords.def: the person who calls the adhan

questions.q: What does 'Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah' mean?
questions.a: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah

questions.q: How many times is 'Allahu akbar' said at the start?
Which prayer has 'prayer is better than sleep'?
Match the six adhan lines to their meanings on the pupil PDF, then write the line you like most and why.
questions.a: Correct matches; for example: 'Come to success' because salah brings real success

questions.q: Extend: why do you think the adhan begins and ends by praising Allah?
questions.a: To remind us Allah is greater than anything we are doing
It pleases Allah and leads to Paradise.
A) Come to success. Falah is success; salah is prayer.

questions.q: The person who calls the adhan is the ...
Think again: would you stop for a call to success? Why?
questions.a: Yes: salah is the real success.
